title: agrostis tremula
intro: Agrostis tremula, commonly known as Red Top Bent or Red Top Grass, is a type of grass native to Europe and Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, making it beneficial for people with asthma or bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis tremula include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help alleviate symptoms such as coughing and difficulty breathing. The bioactive constituents of Agrostis tremula include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
